attributes.probed_form: ONE source probe, MEASURED NEGATIVE and REVERTED: `size *= 0.5;` -> `size *= 0.5f;` in DrawPsysSub, testing whether the f32 parameter's 8-byte home (and so the +8 locals base) was caused by the double-typed literal putting the parameter in a double context. Measured real 192 -> 237, T290/O289, multiset DIFFERS target-only +1 fmul +1 frsp +1 lfd / ours-only -1 fmuls -1 lfs. The probe REFUTES its own premise in the useful direction: the TARGET itself computes size*0.5 in DOUBLE precision, so the double literal is the CORRECT source and double context does not cause the 8-byte parameter home. Reverted via probe.py --revert back to real 192.
attributes.residual: THE FOUR SCREENS, each measured live this run. (1) DrawPsysSub: fndiff --ops reports opcode multiset IDENTICAL (290/290) with 49 IMMEDIATE rows and 3 clusters. 44 of the 49 are a pure +8 r1-displacement shift (target stb r3,36(r1) against ours stb r3,44(r1), aligned at T[23]/O[23] with a byte-identical prologue through +0x58, so the pairing is exact and not a schedule artifact); 5 more carry the +8 AND an FPR rename; the 3 clusters are one 7-atom group (lwz, addi, stfs x5) sitting later in ours. The DECIDING fact is tool.webfrank.20260829.v1's own binding constraint: 'Never broaden a rule or use WebFrank for structural, IMMEDIATE, branch, ABI, semantic, relocation-payload, or data differences.' A recolor rewrites REGISTER FIELDS only and a permutation reorders whole atoms; neither can turn a 36(r1) displacement into 44(r1). So 44+ words of DrawPsysSub are outside every sanctioned class and the function cannot close by this capability no matter how the window is bound. Frame SIZE matches exactly (both stwu r1,-256 and stmw r26,200(r1)); the layouts account for all 256 bytes on both sides and differ only in the locals-block base (target 32..112 with a dead 8-byte gap at 112..120; ours 40..120 with the gap at 32..40), i.e. the outgoing parameter save area, 24 bytes against ours 32. (2) fn_8005F0F4: T661/O660, target-only +1 mr - a COUNT ASYMMETRY, plus 32 IMMEDIATE rows (themselves another uniform +8 r1 shift), base-register swaps r4/r31 and r27/r25, and 126 branch-target rows. Outside every postprocessor class. The work order's framing of this function as 'ONE target-only mr in 661 insns' understates the residual by 32 immediate rows and a displaced lfs pair. (3) ResolveWorldData: T1807/O1805, multiset DIFFERS +2 lfsu +5 li / -2 lfs -3 mr. The four live-zero sites are real and visible (li r0,108 / li r6,0 against ours li r4,0 / li r0,108 at +0xf94, +0x156c, +0x1670, +0x1780) but the function is TWO INSTRUCTIONS SHORT and additionally carries opcode-class (lfsu vs lfs load-update idiom) and address-computation differences (stfs f0,0(r8) against stfs f0,240(r7); lfs f0,0(r10) against lfs f0,8(r9)), so no postprocessor mode can close it and the GT capability request is REFUTED at the function level rather than served. (4) The run-27 refusal corpus: claim.HV_union-resweep-closability-roster-and-its-refusal-taxonomy.20260901.v1 names the bar for all 133 refusals - 92 'no window+order passes the full guard chain', 29 cluster-bound (all re-run at bound 8, 0 of 29 close, explicitly marked do-not-re-derive), 4 renaming-inconsistent, 4 base-register-presence, 5 guard-crash re-runs. NOT ONE refusal is on relocation grounds, so the corpus contains zero members this capability newly serves; and the one relocated window that did arise in that sweep, newcam::fn_8006DF34 ('permute+form+recolor with a relocated window'), was already CLOSED via the pre-recolor placement that already carries verify_relocation_binding. CONCLUSION: the capability has no measured customer. It is sound and its implementation is build-neutral, but it is unexercised surface on a fail-closed postprocessor, and no rule may be authored under it because no function closes byte-exact.

If a source fix to the locals-block base drops it to 0 and the only remaining residual is the 7-atom relocation-carrying window plus the 5 FPR renames, this denial EXPIRES IMMEDIATELY and DrawPsysSub becomes the capability's first genuine customer.
denial.falsifier: Any build of DrawPsysSub whose r1 displacements agree with the target's while the 7-atom FIFO-store window remains displaced would disprove this denial and make the function closable by the capability. Equivalently, a demonstration that any sanctioned webfrank stage can rewrite a D-form displacement field would disprove the categorical half of it.
denial.premise_measurement: python tools/gdl/fndiff.py game/mb/mb_particle.c DrawPsysSub --ops on 2026-09-02: opcode multiset IDENTICAL (290/290), 49 IMMEDIATE rows, 3 clusters. 44 rows are a pure +8 r1-displacement delta on aligned same-opcode words, confirmed exact by python tools/gdl/fnasm.py game/mb/mb_particle.c DrawPsysSub 0x0:0x60 --diff showing the prologue byte-identical through +0x58 with the first divergence at +0x5c (stb r3,36(r1) against stb r3,44(r1)). A displacement is an IMMEDIATE, which tool.webfrank.20260829.v1's constraints place outside every postprocessor class, and neither the recolor (register fields only) nor the permutation (atom reorder) can rewrite one.
denial.scope: ONE axis on ONE function: authoring a webfrank rule for DrawPsysSub under the post_recolor_permutation relocation-binding extension. It does NOT deny the capability's soundness, does NOT deny the pre-recolor stage's use of relocated windows, and does NOT cover the frame-base source axis on DrawPsysSub, which remains OPEN and is the only route by which this function can ever become a customer.

hypothesis.cheapest_refuting_observation: Add one dummy parameter to DrawPsysSub (it is static with call sites in this TU only) and rebuild: if the locals base does not move, the save area is not sized by the parameter list at all and this whole framing is wrong, which would redirect the search to a compiler-flag or callee-declaration cause. That is one build.
hypothesis.screened_against_target: yes - full r1 slot census of both streams plus an aligned prologue read. Frame size, _savefpr_28, stmw r26,200(r1) and every word through +0x58 are byte-identical; the divergence is exactly the locals base. The double-literal explanation for the 8-byte float home was PROBED THIS RUN AND REFUTED: forcing 0.5f made our stream single-precision while the TARGET emits lfd/fmul/frsp, so the target does double arithmetic on size and still keeps a 4-byte home.
hypothesis.statement: Close DrawPsysSub's locals-block base by identifying what makes MWCC reserve a 32-byte outgoing parameter save area where the target reserves 24. The layouts account for all 256 bytes on both sides, the locals block is the SAME 80-byte size and the same reverse-declaration order, the spill region at 120..200 is byte-identical, and every callee is locally prototyped at 3 argument words or fewer (lines 65-69 of mb_particle.c), so the parameter HOME area of DrawPsysSub's own six parameters (5 GPR words plus one float) is the only free variable: the target homes the f32 in 4 bytes for 24 total, ours in 8 for 32.
